content.title: Thunder vs Knicks highlights: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, OKC hold off New York for 59th win
content.text: March 29, 2026Updated March 30, 2026, 12:10 a.m. CTUPDATE: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 30 points and the Thunder held off the Knicks for a 111-100 win Sunday to remain two games up in the loss column atop the Spurs in the Western Conference.Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the OKC Thunder will host Jalen Brunson and the New York Knicks at 6:30 p.m. CT Sunday.OKC (58-16) secured a 131-113 home win over the Chicago Bulls on Friday. New York (48-26) fell short in a 114-103 road loss to the Charlotte Hornets on Thursday.Follow along for live updates throughout tonight's Thunder-Knicks game:Order new book on Thunder's run to NBA titleThunder vs Knicks score updates[ LISTEN UP: Make the "Thunder Buddies" podcast a staple of your starting lineup by following onApple,Spotify andYouTube. ]Final: Thunder 111, Knicks 100 | OKC remains two games up on Spurs in loss columnShai Gilgeous-Alexander: 30 points and 4 assistsJalen Williams: 22 points and 2 assistsChet Holmgren: 16 points and 9 reboundsOKC improves to 59-16 on the season.6:33 left in fourth quarter: Thunder 92, Knicks 91 | Karl-Anthony Towns taking controlKarl-Anthony Towns made and-one layup plus the free throw to trim OKC's lead to 92-91 with 6:33 left in the game. With that, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Chet Holmgren have checked in to try to help the Thunder close this one out.End of the third quarter: Thunder 84, Knicks 78 | SGA extends 20-point streak, OKC leadsShai Gilgeous-Alexander: 20 points and 3 reboundsJalen Williams: 20 points and 2 assistsChet Holmgren: 12 points and 6 reboundsJalen Brunson leads New York with a game-high 25 points. Miles McBride limps to locker room in first game back from hernia injuryIn his first game back after a 28-game absence to a hernia injury, Miles McBride limped to the locker room in the third quarter after diving on the court for a loose ball with Lu Dort.7:20 left in third quarter: Thunder 64, Knicks 58 | Jalen Williams heating upJalen Williams is absolutely cooking. He just sank a mid-range jumper to give himself 20 points on 7-for-8 shooting from the field (1 for 1 from deep) in 21 minutes. OKC has a 64-58 lead with 7:20 left in the third quarter.11:06 left in third quarter: Knicks 54, Thunder 53 | Karl-Anthony Towns commits flagrant-1 foul on Chet HolmgrenChet Holmgren got smacked pretty hard in the face while contesting that layup by Karl-Anthony Towns, who has been given a flagrant foul (penalty 1). It took a second for Chet to get up, but he looks to be fine. He just made both free throws and is staying in the game.Halftime: Thunder 53, Knicks 52 | Jalen Brunson, New York close gapJalen Williams: 13 points and 2 assistsShai Gilgeous-Alexander: 12 points and 3 reboundsLu Dort: 12 points and 1 stealJalen Brunson leads New York with 16 points and 5 rebounds. Thunder fan finally makes halfcourt shot for first winner of seasonEnd of the first quarter: Thunder 26, Knicks 23 | Mikal Bridges giving New York a boostShai Gilgeous-Alexander: 8 points and 3 reboundsLu Dort: 8 points and 1 reboundIsaiah Hartenstein: 2 points and 4 reboundsJalen Brunson and Mikal Bridges lead New York with 7 points apiece.3:50 left in first quarter: Thunder 20, Knicks 15 | Lu Dort off to hot start for OKCLu Dort flew in for that two-handed putback dunk and immediately flexed afterwards. He already has eight points in eight minutes, and OKC has a 20-15 lead over New York at the 3:50 mark. Why Caitlin Clark is in OKC for Thunder vs. Knicks broadcast on NBCWNBA star Caitlin Clark is in OKC to join NBC as a special contributor for its coverage of the Thunder-Knicks game.The former Iowa Hawkeyes guard is making her second appearance with the NBC crew, having previously joined the "Basketball Night in America" broadcast last month for a Knicks-Lakers game. The Thunder came out on top despite being without Jalen Williams and Ajay Mitchell, two players who can apply pressure at the rim with their driving skills. And now that they're both back in the mix, they'll present even more problems for a New York defense that's anchored by Karl-Anthony Towns. Give me OKC in this one.Thunder vs Knicks betting oddsOdds via BetMGM as of Sunday, March 29Odds: Thunder by 8.5Over/under: 224.5Moneyline: OKC -350 | New York +280Thunder vs Knicks injury updatesThunder: Brooks Barnhizer (G League two-way) is probable.
